children: Coastal medium crude Southern Green Canyon eased on Tuesday, dealers said, after the US government offered to loan
companies up to 40 million barrels of oil from the Strategic Petroleum Reserve.
Southern Green Canyon eased $3.50, while flagship medium sour crude Mars eased 50 cents.

The spread between Brent and US West Texas Intermediate crude also widened to as much as $13.30, the most since early May. While a wider spread encourages exports for US crude, high freight rates have curbed demand.

Meanwhile, Saudi Arabia has resumed oil tanker loadings from its Red Sea port of Yanbu after restarting operations on the East-West Pipeline, according to trade sources and shipping data, improving the outlook for oil exports from

Saudi Arabia is also expected to raise official selling prices for crude oil bound for Asia in November, a Reuters survey showed, as Middle East spot crude markets strengthened amid disruptions to supply. While typically high prices for Saudi Arabian crude boosts appetite for US oil among Asian buyers, high freight rates could pose a challenge.

Meanwhile, US crude oil stocks rose by 1.02 million barrels in the week ended September 25, market sources said on Tuesday, citing data from the American Petroleum Institute. US crude oil fell by about 264,000 barrels in the week ended September 25, an extended Reuters poll had showed on Tuesday.
Light Louisiana Sweet for October delivery firmed 50 cents to a midpoint of a $2.50 premium and was seen bid and offered between a $2.00 and $3.00 a barrel premium to US crude futures
Mars Sour eased 50 cents to a midpoint of a 50-cent discount and was seen bid and offered between a 75-cent and 25-cent a barrel discount to US crude futures
